name: Bakonyszentlászló (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bakonyszentlászló: a blue shield with a white figure of Saint Ladislaus on horseback between two stars.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
